feedback: The project is working! I like the blinking "EFAb" display! :-)
setting input pin 2 high and then input pin 1 high makes EFAB go on the display!

Works per "How to test": Try (say) 2Hz clock, turn on SW3 (ui_in[2]) for 'E' blinking on 7seg display, then turn on SW1 (ui_in[0]) to come out of reset and see "EFAb" cycle through on 7seg, then also turn on SW8 (ui_in[7]) to disable blinking. That's all there is to it! Webinar on making/submitting this design: https://youtu.be/UVZK-kmN7wc
